annotations.title: P-Video Edit: change a video with words

description: Edit an existing clip of up to 15 seconds with a plain-language instruction (new sky, new outfit, new style), optionally guided by up to 4 reference pictures. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced. Price: from $0.061 per second (one call: from $0.305 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.305, 10 $0.609, 15 $0.913 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

images.description: Optional reference pictures for the edit (https URLs), up to 4. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

max_seconds.description: Longest the video can be; sets the price. Longer videos are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

video.description: Video to edit as an MP4 link (https), up to 15 seconds. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)
